newsitem.title: USA: Educational to buy Hagerstown Business.
newsitem.headline: Educational to buy Hagerstown Business.

text.p: Educational Medical Inc said on Friday it entered into an agreement to purchase Maryland-based Hagerstown Business College.
Educational Medical, providers of diversified career education, will pay $2.7 million to purchase Hagerstown Business College's assets.
Hagertown, an accredited junior college offering associate degrees and diplomas in business and healthcare curricula, had revenues of approximately $2.4 million for the fiscal year ended October 31.
